rawAnswerText: The quote status for 進行中設計專案01 (PRJ-ACTIVE-001) is Issued. The document number is PRJ-ACTIVE-001-Q1, valid until 2027-12-31, and it is not accepted yet.
進行中設計專案01（PRJ-ACTIVE-001）的報價狀態為已核發，最新文件編號為 PRJ-ACTIVE-001-Q1，有效期限至 2027-12-31，目前尚未接受。

The quote status of Active Design Project 01 is Issued, with document number PRJ-ACTIVE-001-Q1, valid until 2027-12-31, and it is not accepted yet. The total amount is NT$11,665,500 (before tax NT$11,110,000, tax amount NT$555,500).
進行中設計專案01（PRJ-ACTIVE-001）的目前報價狀態為已核發，最新文件編號為 PRJ-ACTIVE-001-Q1，有效期限至 2027-12-31，目前接受狀態為尚未接受。未稅金額為 NT$11,110,000，稅額為 NT$555,500，總計金額為 NT$11,665,500。
